These assays reflect the presence 
of all of plasma or serum antioxi-
dants, including vitamins C and E, 
carotenoids, coenzyme Q10, 
glutathione, uric acid, bilirubin,  
superoxide dismutase, catalase, 
glutathione peroxidase, and  
albumin.
These assays are now commer-
cially available but are currently 
performed only in specialized 
laboratories. Testing botanicals 
also available.
